instructions: Ambiguity hunt. Choose the answer labels, then argue the strongest case for one wrong option in case {label, text}. Set flag to one sentence when that case is defensible or a constraint is missing, else null.

items.stem: A company uses AWS Organizations with all features enabled and has 12 AWS accounts. Employees sign in to business applications through the company's external SAML 2.0 identity provider. The company also runs a mobile app for its customers. The engineers must sign in once and use the AWS CLI with short-term credentials in every account. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.text: Create an IAM user with MFA and an access key for each person in each AWS account, and rotate every access key on a fixed monthly schedule.

options.label: B
options.text: Use IAM Identity Center with the external identity provider as the identity source, and assign permission sets that give access to the AWS accounts.

options.label: C
options.text: Create an IAM identity provider and IAM roles in every AWS account, and build a custom broker that exchanges each sign-in for temporary role credentials.

options.label: D
options.text: Use an Amazon Cognito user pool that federates with the identity providers that the users already have, and an identity pool that issues temporary AWS credentials.

items.stem: A company has a mobile app in which customers record home-repair requests. Customers already sign in to the app through an Amazon Cognito user pool, and the app sends the user pool tokens to the company's API. A new feature saves photos from the device directly to an Amazon S3 bucket with temporary credentials, and each customer's photos go under a prefix for that customer. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST securely?

options.label: A
options.text: Send the user pool ID token with each Amazon S3 request, and add a bucket policy that allows requests that carry a valid token from the pool.

options.label: B
options.text: Create one IAM user for the app, keep its access key in encrypted storage on each device, and allow the user to write to the bucket.

options.label: C
options.text: Add a Cognito identity pool with the user pool as its provider, and give the authenticated role access to the prefix that matches each identity ID.

options.label: D
options.text: Add a Cognito identity pool with the user pool as its provider, and give the authenticated role write access to every prefix in the bucket.

items.stem: A company has an Active Directory domain in its on-premises data center and a Site-to-Site VPN connection between the data center and a VPC. The company is moving several workloads to AWS. The domain controllers can be reached from the VPC. Employees must sign in to Amazon WorkSpaces with their existing AD credentials, and user accounts must remain only in the on-premises directory. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.text: Create an AD Connector in the VPC that points to the on-premises domain controllers, and register the directory with the AWS services that need it.

options.label: B
options.text: Launch Amazon EC2 instances in the VPC as additional domain controllers of the on-premises domain, and let Active Directory replicate the whole domain to the instances.

options.label: C
options.text: Create a Simple AD directory in the VPC, and create a two-way trust between the Simple AD directory and the on-premises domain.

options.label: D
options.text: Create an AWS Managed Microsoft AD directory in the VPC, and create a two-way forest trust between that directory and the on-premises domain.

items.stem: A company uses IAM Identity Center for access to 30 AWS accounts in AWS Organizations. The identity source is an on-premises Active Directory that is connected through AD Connector. The company is moving all workforce identities to Okta. Employees must sign in to the AWS accounts with their Okta credentials, and the company wants to automate the creation of new hires in IAM Identity Center. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Select TWO.)

options.label: A
options.text: Create an IAM SAML identity provider for Okta in each of the 30 member accounts, and create IAM roles in each account that trust the provider.

options.label: B
options.text: Keep AD Connector as the identity source, and add Okta to IAM Identity Center as a second identity source for the employees who use Okta.

options.label: C
options.text: Change the identity source of IAM Identity Center to an external identity provider, and connect Okta through SAML 2.0 with the IAM Identity Center metadata.

options.label: D
options.text: Turn on automatic provisioning in IAM Identity Center, and configure Okta to send users and groups to the SCIM endpoint with a bearer token.

options.label: E
options.text: Connect Okta to an Amazon Cognito user pool, and set the user pool as the identity source of IAM Identity Center for all employees.

items.stem: A company uses AWS Organizations with all features enabled and has 12 AWS accounts. Employees sign in to business applications through the company's external SAML 2.0 identity provider. The company also runs a mobile app for its customers. The app's customers must sign in with Google and upload photos to Amazon S3 with short-term credentials. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.text: Create an IAM identity provider and IAM roles in every AWS account, and build a custom broker that exchanges each sign-in for temporary role credentials.

options.label: B
options.text: Create an IAM user with MFA and an access key for each person in each AWS account, and rotate every access key on a fixed monthly schedule.

options.label: C
options.text: Use IAM Identity Center with the external identity provider as the identity source, and assign permission sets that give access to the AWS accounts.

options.label: D
options.text: Use an Amazon Cognito user pool that federates with the identity providers that the users already have, and an identity pool that issues temporary AWS credentials.

items.stem: A company has one AWS account and does not use AWS Organizations. The company runs AWS Managed Microsoft AD in a VPC for its Windows workloads, and its ten administrators have user accounts in this directory. The administrators must use the AWS Management Console with their directory credentials. The company wants to avoid IAM users. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.text: Create an IAM user for each administrator with the same name and password as in the directory, and require MFA for each IAM user.

options.label: B
options.text: Create an organization in AWS Organizations, enable an organization instance of IAM Identity Center, connect the directory as its identity source, and assign permission sets to the administrators.

options.label: C
options.text: Enable an account instance of IAM Identity Center in the account, connect the directory, and assign permission sets to the administrators' group.

options.label: D
options.text: Create an access URL for the directory, assign an IAM role to the directory group of the administrators, and let them sign in at that URL.

items.stem: A company has an Active Directory domain in its on-premises data center and a Site-to-Site VPN connection between the data center and a VPC. The company is moving several workloads to AWS. The domain controllers can be reached from the VPC. Amazon RDS for SQL Server databases must use Windows Authentication with the employees' existing AD accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.text: Create an AWS Managed Microsoft AD directory in the VPC, and create a two-way forest trust between that directory and the on-premises domain.

options.label: B
options.text: Launch Amazon EC2 instances in the VPC as additional domain controllers of the on-premises domain, and let Active Directory replicate the whole domain to the instances.

options.label: C
options.text: Create an AD Connector in the VPC that points to the on-premises domain controllers, and register the directory with the AWS services that need it.

options.label: D
options.text: Create a Simple AD directory in the VPC, and create a two-way trust between the Simple AD directory and the on-premises domain.

items.stem: A company runs a hybrid environment. Its on-premises data center has two Active Directory forests, and AWS Direct Connect links the data center to a VPC in the AWS Organizations management account. The company uses IAM Identity Center for access to many AWS accounts. Employees from both forests must sign in to IAM Identity Center with their existing Active Directory credentials. What is the MOST operationally efficient way to meet these requirements?

options.label: A
options.text: Create AWS Managed Microsoft AD in the management account, create a two-way forest trust to each forest, and set the directory as the identity source.

options.label: B
options.text: Create one AD Connector for each forest in the management account, and connect both AD Connector directories to IAM Identity Center as identity sources.

options.label: C
options.text: Create AWS Managed Microsoft AD in the management account, create a one-way forest trust to each forest, and set the directory as the identity source.

options.label: D
options.text: Migrate the users of both forests into AWS Managed Microsoft AD with the Active Directory Migration Toolkit (ADMT), and set the directory as the identity source.

items.stem: A company hosts an internet-facing web application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The load balancer has an HTTPS listener with a certificate. The company sells the application to business customers. Each customer's employees must sign in with that customer's corporate SAML 2.0 identity provider before any request reaches the instances. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.label: A
options.text: Put an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API in front of the load balancer, and write a Lambda authorizer that validates the SAML assertions of each customer.

options.label: B
options.text: Create a Cognito user pool with each customer's SAML identity provider, and add an authenticate-cognito action to a new HTTP listener on port 80.

options.label: C
options.text: Create a Cognito user pool with each customer's SAML identity provider, and add an authenticate-cognito action to the rules of the existing HTTPS listener.

options.label: D
options.text: Add each customer's SAML identity provider to IAM Identity Center as an identity source, and assign the web application to each customer's employees.

items.stem: A company uses AWS Organizations with all features enabled and manages workforce access with IAM Identity Center. An administrator creates a permission set that holds an AWS managed policy for read-only access. The administrator assigns the permission set to the group of auditors for one member account. Later, a security engineer reviews the IAM resources of that member account. What does the engineer find that IAM Identity Center created for this assignment?

options.label: A
options.text: A resource-based policy on each resource in the account that names the auditors group

options.label: B
options.text: One IAM group for the auditors, with the read-only policy attached to the IAM group

options.label: C
options.text: One IAM role whose name begins with AWSReservedSSO_ and that has the read-only policy

options.label: D
options.text: One IAM user for each auditor, with a console password and the read-only policy

items.stem: A company builds a mobile quiz app. People can play before they create an account, and the app writes each quiz result to an Amazon DynamoDB table directly from the device. The writes must use temporary AWS credentials. Players who have not signed in must also be able to save their results, and the company will add sign-in later. Which Amazon Cognito feature gives the players who have not signed in these credentials?

options.label: A
options.text: A user pool app client that is created without a client secret

options.label: B
options.text: An identity pool that allows guest access and has an unauthenticated IAM role

options.label: C
options.text: An IAM Identity Center permission set that is assigned to each player

options.label: D
options.text: A user pool group that has an IAM role attached to the user pool group

items.stem: A company runs a web application whose users sign in through an Amazon Cognito user pool. The application calls a REST API in Amazon API Gateway, and AWS Lambda functions run behind the API. The company must restrict the API so that it accepts requests only from users who signed in to the application. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.label: A
options.text: Associate an AWS WAF web ACL with the API stage, and allow requests only from the IP address ranges of the users of the application.

options.label: B
options.text: Set the API methods to AWS_IAM authorization, create an IAM user with an access key for each customer, and sign each request to the API with that access key.

options.label: C
options.text: Create an authorizer of the COGNITO_USER_POOLS type for the user pool, enable it on the API methods, and send the user's token in the Authorization header.

options.label: D
options.text: Create a Lambda authorizer that downloads the signing keys of the user pool, validates each token in custom code, and returns an IAM policy.
